name: Light Tank Chassis
short_description: Fast scout tank with better side armour.
description: A fast, lightly armoured chassis built for scouting and flanking runs. Improves side armour resilience while shifting columns in combat.

name: Medium Tank Chassis
short_description: Balanced tank, the backbone of a mechanised force.
description: A balanced mix of armour and mobility. This is the doctrine backbone a mechanised infantry force builds around.

name: Heavy Tank Chassis
short_description: Slow tank with heavy front armour.
description: Thick front armour built to shrug off standard anti tank fire, at the cost of speed.

name: Mechanised Infantry (APC)
short_description: Half track transport for infantry riding with your tanks.
description: A half track transport that lets infantry ride alongside a panzer division. Carries partial armour and can't be fully suppressed by machine gun fire alone.

name: Improved APC
short_description: Full tracked upgrade with more armour.
description: A full tracked hull replaces the half track. Better off road speed, more armour, and more suppression resistance. This is a new grid entity, not a stat patch on the old one.

name: IFV
short_description: Top of the line, fires back on its own.
description: An infantry fighting vehicle that provides its own fire support, on top of the Improved APC's protection. The top of the mechanised infantry lineage chain.
